# Hrishita Bapuram

> Hrishita Bapuram is a data scientist at AXA Insurance Ireland, based in Dublin
> and originally from Mumbai. She works in the Pricing, Underwriting & Customer
> Analytics function on causal inference, uplift modelling and production ML,
> and builds agentic systems on the Claude API and MCP. She is also the author of
> the novel *Dotted Lines*. This is her personal site at hrishitabapuram.com.

A single-page portfolio laid out as a Jupyter notebook that executes as you
scroll. Sections are anchors on one page, not separate URLs.

## About

Gold-medal statistics degree from Mumbai, then data science in Dublin. Her work
sits close to commercial decisions rather than at arm's length from them: lead
prioritisation, segmentation, cross-sell, retention. Alongside that she is
building toward deep learning and LLM systems engineering rather than
application-layer work.

Outside that: cooking, photography, reading, tennis and video games. A lifelong
Agatha Christie devotee and an unrepentant Potterhead.

## Work experience

- **AXA Insurance Ireland (2023-present)** - Data Scientist, Pricing,
  Underwriting & Customer Analytics. Built an end-to-end lead prioritisation
  model on causal inference and A/B testing that delivered a **6% lift in
  lead-to-sale conversion** on new business, later extended to renewals and
  win-back with automated retraining pipelines. Also multi-dimensional customer
  segmentation embedded in enterprise BI for senior leadership, and real-time
  dashboards tracking campaign KPIs and model performance.
- Earlier internships across health analytics, public-health research and
  markets research.

## Current projects

- **Arc** - a multi-agent personal operating system built on the Claude API.
  Independent agents own separate domains (tasks, calendar, fitness, meals,
  budget) with a council layer above them that reasons across all five and
  resolves competing priorities into a single daily plan.
- **TARA** - Tax, Assets & Residency Advisor. Part of an MCP-based financial
  intelligence system: Model Context Protocol servers exposing verified domain
  knowledge (tax rules, portfolio optimisation, investment strategy) as
  something an AI tool can query rather than approximate. Aimed at tax
  obligations spanning more than one residency.

## Public projects

At https://github.com/hbapuram - stock prediction from Reddit sentiment with an
LSTM, quantile regression across global exchanges, crypto portfolio
optimisation, non-invasive haemoglobin prediction, Dublin housing analysis, and
air quality analysis in Indian cities.

## Writing

**Dotted Lines** (New Degree Press) - a novel about women, technology,
empowerment, self-discovery and Indian culture, written as a PEP Fellow at the
Creators Institute.

## Teaching & talks

- **Journey of AI to ChatGPT** - a recorded session for students, volunteering
  with Coding and More: how the separate parts of the field converged into one
  product, and what transformers, encoders and attention heads actually do.
  https://youtu.be/PL41ej9VRVM
- **Artificial Intelligence Educator, Coding and More (2022-23)** - taught ML and
  AI fundamentals through Python projects and mentored students into the
  Microsoft Imagine Cup Junior Hackathon.

## Skills

Python, R, scikit-learn, causal inference, uplift modelling, A/B testing,
propensity scoring, back-testing, Keras, Stan/RStan, Shiny, SQL, git, Azure,
SAS. Claude API, MCP servers, agentic workflows, tool use, RAG, evals.

## Certifications

CPQFRM (Quantitative Finance & Risk Management, Indian Institute of Quantitative
Finance); Claude - 101, Agents, Skills & MCP Servers (Anthropic via DataCamp);
Winter School on Deep Learning (Indian Statistical Institute); SAS Certified
Specialist: Visual Business Analytics; HarvardX Data Science.
